why: The must_catch list has one item: the stage must answer blocked and say the request is a question that asks for no change. The output does exactly that. It is a "blocked" object, and its reason says the request "is a question, not a change" and "does not ask for any change to the repository (no migration to ESM, no documentation update)". It also explains that a builder would have nothing to build and a verifier nothing to check. No issue was drafted alongside the block, so the whole output meets the criterion.
